rules.title: How to play
rules.s1: Everyone gets the same secret word. The spy gets a hint instead, or nothing.
rules.s2: Take turns giving one short clue about your word. Not too obvious!
rules.s3: Talk it over and vote: who is the spy?
rules.s4: Caught? The spy can still win by guessing the word.
rules.win: Civilians win if they catch the spy. The spy wins if nobody finds them, or by guessing the word.
rules.players: 3 or more players. Pass one phone around, or everyone uses their own.

seo.title: Spy – free online party word game (like Undercover & Imposter)
seo.description: Free word game for 3 or more players. Everyone gets a secret word, the spy gets a hint. Play on one phone or everyone on their own. No sign-up.
seo.intro: Free in your browser, no account needed. Pass one phone around the table, or let everyone join a room on their own phone.
